findings.summary: The terminal-state assertion accepts any drain reason as a board terminal state, so acceptance criterion 4's '板面无终态 ⇒ 入口非零退出' arm is empty — exactly the '判据是空的' shape spec §3 forbids ('⛔ 不得为了让判据过而放宽判据本身 … 把终态断言改成"没报错就算过"'). scripts/e0-terminal-state.mjs returns drain.reason verbatim whenever rounds >= 1, and bin/e0-verify.sh only fails when TERM_STATE is empty or the literal 'null'. Therefore reason='max_rounds' passes: TERM_STATE='max_rounds' is non-empty and != 'null', so e0-verify prints 'PASS: … terminal state=max_rounds' and the entry exits 0. max_rounds is this repo's own documented deadlock signature for a board that never reached a terminal state ('永不 drained，恒 max_rounds', docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_a10c_writebudget_01.md:13; '撞 max_passes 退出，不是 drained', docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_a10b_converge_02.md:9), and scripts/e0-terminal-state.mjs:16 even lists {"reason":"max_rounds","rounds":16} among the inputs it accepts as terminal. The weakness is not limited to max_rounds: 'rounds' counts drain passes, not board termination. A reachable healthy-looking run — seed 1 clue, tick 1 dispatches (in_flight), tick 2 harvests evidence (coverage 0→1 ⇒ zeroGrowthRounds resets to 0 per src/tick.ts:362-363) and CASes the card to explored with no new clue — ends with hasPendingWork false ⇒ no continuation ⇒ reason='drained', rounds>=1, tick head_seq grown (Z1 passes), while decideTermination yields state=null (capHit false: 1 card < maxClues 64, depth 0 < maxDepth 3; zeroGrowthRounds 0 < zeroGrowthThreshold 2, src/tick.ts:375-390). The board has no terminal state and the entry still exits 0. The board's real termination.state was obtainable without fabricating any contract: it is carried in the tick run_output that the engine captures into <run_dir>/journal.jsonl (reachable from the drain summary's drain_id via index.jsonl, exactly as scripts/check-drain-failures.mjs:17-62 already does), or via the read-only, zero-write 'bin/tick-entry.sh --inspect <channel>' whose JSON includes termination (src/tick-inspect.ts:129-179).

Discriminating coverage for criterion 4 is missing for the only arm that criterion 4 adds beyond Z1, so the weakened assertion is unguarded (判别性缺失 per spec §4). T-VERIFY-TERMINAL only exercises two cases: drain rounds == 0, and a run.stdout.log with no drain summary at all. Both are already implied by Z1 in practice — rounds == 0 means no tick ran, hence no CAS and no tick head_seq growth, so bin/e0-verify.sh:51-54 would already fail. No test constructs the case the criterion actually names: a run where the loop did work (rounds >= 1, head_seq grew) yet the board reached no terminal state (reason='max_rounds', or 'drained' with termination.state === null) must exit non-zero. T-VERIFY-DRAIN (test/e0-regression.test.ts:584-683) only pins the healthy direction (fake CLI emitting {"reason":"drained","rounds":1} ⇒ exit 0), so replacing the terminal check with an unconditional pass, or feeding it a max_rounds summary, leaves the suite green. Per the spec's reviewer warning, this is the same 'mock 全绿 ≠ 判据成立' shape the package exists to prevent.

Acceptance criterion 6 requires that the name 'board:agent-runs' have exactly one source of truth in the repo. bin/e0-regression.sh:162 correctly introduces BOARD_AGENT_RUNS_CHANNEL for the channel-preparation list, but the literal string remains hardcoded as a production default in several other places (src/tick-run.ts:1489, src/tick-inspect.ts:236, 273, 308, 352), so the repo still has multiple truth sources for that name. These occurrences are pre-existing (A8b/A8e) and outside the two root causes spec §1 scopes this package to, hence non-blocking, but criterion 6 is not literally satisfied.

The e0-verify header documentation contradicts the code and understates the weakening. Lines 6-12 still describe <run-stdout> as the input '供从中真解析 termination.state', while lines 17-20 and the implementation actually parse the loop-engine drain summary and treat rounds >= 1 as '跑到终态'. Whichever way the blocker above is resolved, this header should state precisely what is asserted so a reader cannot mistake the drain reason for the board's termination.state.
